# Pages: Classic Pages

<!-- Generated by pageslens from the site configuration. Do not edit by hand; run `pageslens docs` again. -->

Who can read each page, from the page access rules. A rule applies to its page and every page below it. With no Restrict Read rule on the way down, anyone can open a page. A user needs one role of every Restrict Read rule on the way down: pageslens assumes nested rules narrow access, which is still to be checked in an environment. A Grant Change role can read its whole branch, whatever Restrict Read says. Each page stands for all its language versions.

| Page | URL | Who can read | Restrict Read | Grant Change | Site map |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Home | `/` | anyone |  |  |  |
| Account | `/account/` | every signed-in user | Signed-in Only |  | hidden |
| Docs | `/docs/` | Administrators, Employees | Docs Readers | Writers Publish Docs |  |
| Internal | `/internal/` | Employees, Managers | Employees Only |  |  |
| Reports | `/internal/reports/` | Managers | Managers and Partners<br>Employees Only (on `/internal/`) |  |  |
| Team | `/internal/team/` | Managers | Managers Only<br>Employees Only (on `/internal/`) |  |  |
| Locked | `/locked/` | nobody | Locked Without Role |  |  |
| Loop B | `/loop-a/loop-b/` | unknown: the parent pages loop at "Loop A" |  |  |  |
| Loop A | `/loop-b/loop-a/` | unknown: the parent pages loop at "Loop B" |  |  |  |
| Lost | `/lost/` | unknown: the parent of "Lost" isn't in the site |  |  |  |
| Lost Child | `/lost/child/` | unknown: the parent of "Lost" isn't in the site |  |  |  |
| Members | `/members/` | every signed-in user | Members and Admins |  |  |
| Public | `/public/` | anyone | Public Visitors |  |  |
| Shared | `/shared/` | Employees, Partners | Shared A<br>Shared B |  |  |

## Grant Change

These roles can publish changes to, and read, the page and every page below it.

| Rule | Page | Roles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Writers Publish Docs | `/docs/` | Administrators |

## Page access rules

Scope only matters for the web files directly under the page: "Exclude direct child web files" leaves them out of the rule.

| Rule | Right | Page | Roles | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Docs Readers | Restrict Read | `/docs/` | Employees | All content |
| Employees Only | Restrict Read | `/internal/` | Employees, Managers | All content |
| Grant Change Without Role | Grant Change | `/` | none | All content |
| Grant Change to Content | Grant Change | none (applies to nothing) | none | All content |
| Locked Without Role | Restrict Read | `/locked/` | none | All content |
| Managers Only | Restrict Read | `/internal/team/` | Managers | All content |
| Managers and Partners | Restrict Read | `/internal/reports/` | Managers, Partners | All content |
| Members and Admins | Restrict Read | `/members/` | Administrators, Authenticated Users | All content |
| Orphan Rule | Restrict Read | none (applies to nothing) | Employees | All content |
| Public Visitors | Restrict Read | `/public/` | Anonymous Users | All content |
| Shared A | Restrict Read | `/shared/` | Employees | All content |
| Shared B | Restrict Read | `/shared/` | Partners | All content |
| Signed-in Only | Restrict Read | `/account/` | Authenticated Users | All content |
| Writers Publish Docs | Grant Change | `/docs/` | Administrators | All content |
